facts.fact: The Namibian reports in April 2026 that the final draft of the cybercrime bill was circulated ahead of a validation workshop convened by the Ministry of Information and Communication Technology, before it goes to parliament.
nbc reports the Ministry of Information and Communication Technology is consulting on a draft Cybercrime Bill, with written submissions due by 10 February 2026.
Minister Emma Theofelus said consultations on the draft Cybercrime Bill, covering online harassment, cyberstalking, image-based abuse and deepfakes, resume in February 2026.

The Institute for Public Policy Research described the draft Cybercrime Bill in a July briefing as incompatible with the Constitution in many respects, and the NMT Media Foundation made a February 2026 submission on the bill; no law in force is stated.
